# Camera Selection Requirements Checklist: Hybrid Camera Selection

**Purpose**: Validate that the camera-selection requirements are complete, clear, consistent, and ready for planning  
**Created**: 2026-06-16  
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are the requirements explicit that the Target-Aware Spatial Greedy selector is the single intended selector behaviour, not a family of alternatives? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK002 Are patch-body, patch-boundary, target-region, halo/spillover, local, and nonlocal/support camera concepts all defined well enough for planning to use one consistent vocabulary? [Completeness, Spec §Key Entities]
- [ ] CHK003 Are requirements present for low sparse-point or low-texture target regions where matched scene evidence may be weak? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, §FR-005, §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK004 Are requirements present for local cameras that are physically inside a patch but do not meaningfully observe the patch target? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 1, §Edge Cases, §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK005 Are requirements present for neighbouring/support cameras that genuinely improve body or boundary coverage? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 1, §User Story 2, §FR-008, §FR-013]
- [ ] CHK006 Are requirements present for cameras that mostly contain halo/spillover outside the patch target? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, §FR-009, §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK007 Are requirements present for dense textured areas that could otherwise dominate selection through raw matched-point counts? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK008 Are requirements present for redundant candidate views from one direction and the need for useful viewing-direction diversity? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, §FR-014]
- [ ] CHK009 Are requirements present for existing patch outputs generated by older selector-affecting settings? [Completeness, Spec §User Story 4, §FR-022, §FR-023]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK010 Is the Target-Aware Spatial Greedy selector specified clearly enough in behavioural terms to avoid reintroducing tracks-only, projection-only, or fixed-quota selectors during planning? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001, §FR-005, §FR-012, §FR-013]
- [ ] CHK011 Is "stored patch bounds" clearly specified as the target region so planning cannot accidentally add a second buffer? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003, §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK012 Is "poor selector coverage" clear enough as a warning condition without implying that patch outputs become invalid or blocked from training? [Clarity, Spec §Clarifications, §FR-019]
- [ ] CHK013 Is "disadvantage" for spillover-heavy cameras clear enough as a continuous preference rather than a hard exclusion? [Clarity, Spec §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK014 Is "diverse viewing directions" clear enough as a selection goal while leaving the exact binning and scoring details for `plan.md`? [Clarity, Spec §FR-014]
- [ ] CHK015 Is "single supported behaviour" clear enough to prevent public configs from growing a selector-mode switch? [Clarity, Spec §User Story 4, §FR-001, §FR-002]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK016 Do the support-camera requirements consistently allow nonlocal cameras to win on target usefulness while still discouraging halo/spillover waste? [Consistency, Spec §FR-006, §FR-008, §FR-009, §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK017 Do the poor-coverage requirements consistently keep poor-coverage patches trainable by default while still requiring visible warnings? [Consistency, Spec §Clarifications, §User Story 3, §FR-016, §FR-019]
- [ ] CHK018 Do the diagnostic requirements align with the success criteria that researchers should inspect selection quality without reading terminal output? [Consistency, Spec §FR-016, §FR-017, §FR-018, §SC-005]
- [ ] CHK019 Do the out-of-scope statements consistently exclude training, cleanup, merging, SOG compression, COLMAP reconstruction, and patch-bound generation from this feature? [Consistency, Spec §FR-024]
- [ ] CHK020 Do the resume/overwrite requirements align with the project-wide rule that decisions happen up front before patch work begins? [Consistency, Spec §User Story 4, §FR-022, §FR-023, §SC-006]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK021 Are Dataset 1, Dataset 2, and Polish-town validation outcomes specific enough to become measurable acceptance checks during planning? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001, §SC-002, §SC-003]
- [ ] CHK022 Is the 95 percent local camera-position coverage target tied clearly to the normal camera cap and validation datasets? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]
- [ ] CHK023 Are the current-selector baseline comparison artefacts accounted for in tasks or validation reporting? [Completeness, Spec §SC-001, Tasks §Phase 7]
- [ ] CHK024 Is "no large unrepresented local acquisition strip" defined well enough for planning to derive an objective diagnostic threshold? [Ambiguity, Spec §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK025 Are success criteria separated from implementation mechanics so they can be verified by diagnostics and reports rather than code internals? [Measurability, Spec §Success Criteria]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK026 Are primary reef scenarios represented separately from oblique/urban-style scenarios so neither validation set is accidentally dropped? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 1, §User Story 2, §SC-001, §SC-003]
- [ ] CHK027 Are exception scenarios for malformed metadata, missing sparse outputs, and inconsistent image names included as blocking input failures? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, §FR-020]
- [ ] CHK028 Are warning-only scenarios for diagnostic export failure and poor selector coverage covered separately from blocking input failures? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 3, §FR-019, §FR-020, §FR-021]
- [ ] CHK029 Are regeneration scenarios for old selector outputs covered without requiring mid-run prompts? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 4, §FR-022, §FR-023, §SC-006]
- [ ] CHK030 Are small test dataset and large reef patch validation scenarios both covered before any expensive retraining decision? [Coverage, Spec §SC-007, §Assumptions]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK031 Does the spec define expected requirements for patches with too few usable target observations beyond warning visibility and default trainability? [Gap, Spec §Edge Cases, §FR-019]
- [ ] CHK032 Does the spec define how requirements treat a patch where ideal coverage cannot fit under the configured maximum camera count? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, §FR-015]
- [ ] CHK033 Does the spec define requirements for support cameras that see a useful boundary but very little patch body? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 2, §FR-010, §FR-013]
- [ ] CHK034 Does the spec define requirements for candidate sets with highly redundant views from one direction? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, §FR-014]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK035 Are observability requirements complete enough for researchers to audit selector decisions patch by patch? [Completeness, Spec §User Story 3, §FR-016, §FR-017, §FR-018]
- [ ] CHK036 Are selector performance expectations captured in the plan clearly enough to keep selection small relative to LFS training? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions, Plan §Technical Context]
- [ ] CHK037 Are data-safety requirements clear that source SfM outputs are not modified by selector validation or diagnostic generation? [Completeness, Spec §SC-007, Plan §Technical Context]
- [ ] CHK038 Are public-config simplicity requirements clear enough to prevent extra user-facing knobs unless genuinely necessary? [Clarity, Spec §User Story 4, §FR-002]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK039 Are dependencies on Feature 3 patch generation, metadata, selected-image export, diagnostics, and resume handling documented clearly enough for planning? [Dependency, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK040 Are scratch experiment reports identified as evidence rather than normative implementation documents? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK041 Are assumptions about stored patch bounds including the buffer stated consistently in requirements and assumptions? [Consistency, Spec §FR-003, §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK042 Are selector-affecting settings defined sufficiently for planning to decide when existing patch outputs are incompatible? [Completeness, Spec §FR-023, Plan §Run Record Contract]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [ ] CHK043 Is the validation comparison against the current selector framed as baseline evidence rather than a public selector mode? [Consistency, Spec §FR-002, §SC-001, Plan §Research Summary]
- [ ] CHK044 Is "meaningfully cover the patch target region" clear enough for planning to turn into objective warning and selection criteria? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK045 Is "excessive support-camera use" specified clearly enough as a diagnostic concern without imposing a hard support quota? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-018]
- [ ] CHK046 Are all measurable outcomes traceable to at least one user story and one functional requirement? [Traceability, Spec §User Scenarios, §Functional Requirements, §Success Criteria]

## Notes

- This checklist validates the quality of Feature 006 requirements writing. It does not verify implementation behaviour.
- Items marked with `[Gap]`, `[Ambiguity]`, or `[Conflict]` should be reviewed before or during `speckit-plan`.
- If an item is intentionally deferred to planning, note the rationale beside the checked item rather than expanding `spec.md` with implementation detail.
